title: Цитирование и согласие с оценкой
description: Цитирование и согласие с оценкой: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Отличать приведённую оценку от позиции автора
notes: Кавычки и reporting clause могут приписывать слова другому человеку.
Сам факт цитирования не устанавливает согласие автора; позицию проверяют по продолжению.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: “The mayor called it flawless; the reviewer disputed that.” Who endorsed flawless?
exercises.explanation: Оценка приписана мэру, а рецензент спорит с ней.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: at / to.

public_payload.sentence: The phrase was attributed ___ the mayor.

exercises.editorial_answer: The phrase was attributed to the mayor.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Цитирование оценки не обязательно означает её одобрение.»
exercises.editorial_answer: Quoting a judgement does not necessarily endorse it.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The judgement was attributed at the speaker.

accepted: The judgement was attributed to the speaker.

exercises.reference_answer: The judgement was attributed to the speaker.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The judgement was attributed at the speaker.
exercises.editorial_answer: The judgement was attributed to the speaker.

public_payload.passage: A review opened by quoting the organiser’s description of the exhibition as flawless. The following paragraphs questioned that description, pointing to unclear labels and a missing explanation of the central display. A promotional extract reproduced the word flawless beside the reviewer’s name, omitting the attribution and the objections. The reviewer requested its removal. Her article had accurately reported the organiser’s praise before examining it critically; it had not adopted that praise as its own conclusion. Correcting the extract required more than keeping quotation marks around one adjective. Readers needed to know whose judgement it was and how the review treated it. Without that context, an accurate fragment could convey a position opposite to the one developed in the complete article.

options.label: The reviewer as her final conclusion.

exercises.explanation: Статья приводила слова организатора перед критикой.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: quotation — цитата; endorsement — одобрение; attribution — указание авторства; rebuttal — возражение
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: quotation — цитата; endorsement — одобрение; attribution — указание авторства; rebuttal — возражение.
